raw_response:
Useful existing mechanisms for the initialization problem

1. Dart initializing-formal parameters and initializer lists — https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-408_4th_edition_december_2015.pdf
Dart's initializing formals remove repetitive argument-to-field assignments inside authored constructors while initializer lists retain explicit control of other state. This covers final fields and optional inputs, but each constructor still selects its parameters and must obey initialization rules. Verified before the cutoff in ECMA-408, December 2015, section 10.6.1.

2. Lombok required/all-arguments constructor generation — https://projectlombok.org/features/constructor
Lombok demonstrates generating field-assignment constructors alongside custom constructors, with explicit access levels and selection based on uninitialized final or non-null fields. Signature collisions and Java compiler integration are transfer constraints. Current documentation and public implementation were verified; historical availability of the verified version is unknown.

3. Scala case-class construction and generated copy — https://www.scala-lang.org/downloads/distrib/files/website/doc/ScalaReference.pdf
Scala case classes generate immutable-by-default parameter fields and construction/copy methods, reducing assignments and supporting replacement values without mutating an existing object. Parameter membership also influences accessors and value semantics, so internal state needs separate design. Verified in the specification dated May 24, 2011, section 5.3.2.

4. Immutables default, derived, and lazy attributes — https://immutables.github.io/immutable.html
Immutables separates caller-supplied attributes from author-computed derived or lazy attributes while generating immutable implementations and construction helpers. Dependency cycles and lazy-attribute equality semantics require explicit treatment. The opened documentation is live; its availability by the cutoff remains unknown.

5. Kotlin primary-constructor properties and initializer blocks — https://kotlinlang.org/docs/classes.html
Kotlin combines read-only constructor properties, defaults, ordinary parameters, and authored initializer blocks to centralize automatic assignments and custom initialization. Initialization order and shallow read-only references remain constraints. This is verified current documentation with unknown pre-cutoff availability.

6. Common Lisp slot initialization protocol — https://www.lispworks.com/documentation/HyperSpec/Body/07_a.htm
Common Lisp separates selected initialization arguments, default slot forms, and customizable initialization methods, allowing automatic slot filling plus author-owned setup. The transferable part is the division of responsibilities; immutable slots and definite initialization require additional rules. The live page has no verified publication date.

7. Lombok builders on constructors or factory methods — https://projectlombok.org/features/Builder
A generated builder can collect selected inputs separately and invoke an author-chosen constructor or factory to produce the final object. This provides a distinct construction route but adds mutable staging state and another API. The current page is verified; its later default/access features are not assumed available before the cutoff.

8. attrs 16.1.0 generated initializers and frozen instances — https://www.attrs.org/en/16.1.0/api.html
attrs combines per-field initializer inclusion, defaults/factories, conversion/validation, and frozen instances to automate selected inputs while initializing internal state. This is explicitly later evidence: the opened changelog dates excluded-field default initialization to May 23, 2016 and frozen support to August 30, 2016. Freezing is a runtime, best-effort mechanism.
